deepseek_v4_integration_golden_rules.methodology_name: Open Code CLI + DeepSeek V4 API – Golden Rules for Developer

rules.title: Context priming before code generation
rules.description: Always provide DeepSeek V4 with: (a) exact function signature, (b) expected input/output examples, (c) relevant existing code snippets (max 200 lines), (d) constraints (no new dependencies, maintain backward compatibility).
rules.example_prompt: I need to implement fix_proximity_matrix(entities). Current proximity_matrix returns zeros. Use shapely.STRtree to compute min Euclidean distance between entity bounding boxes. Existing code: [paste 50 lines]. Output format: n×n list of floats. Do not import new libraries beyond shapely.

rules.title: Iterative validation loop
rules.description: After each generated code block, run the CLI on 3 test DXF files. Compare output with previous golden master. If mismatch >0.1% in numeric fields, rollback and refine prompt.
rules.tooling: Use diff tool on JSON outputs (ignore timestamp and metadata).

rules.title: Configuration over code
rules.description: Never hardcode machine parameters (speeds, extensions, penalties). Always read from dxf_tool_config.json. If DeepSeek suggests hardcoded values, reject and ask to reference config keys.
rules.verification: grep for hardcoded numbers in generated code – only allowed are mathematical constants (0, 1, 2, π) and config defaults.

rules.title: Determinism by design
rules.description: Every generated function must be pure (no random, no time, no file system reads except explicit config). Output must be deterministic given same input DXF and config. Reject any suggestion using string matching on layer names or file names.
rules.test: Run same DXF twice with different file names → JSON must be identical (except metadata.file_name).

rules.title: Epistemic transparency
rules.description: For any heuristic (e.g., density penalty, corner slowdown), the code must output its validation_status ('empirical', 'calibrated', 'hypothesis') alongside the value. Ask DeepSeek to add _status fields.

rules.title: Modular ask, modular answer
rules.description: Request changes function‑by‑function, not whole file rewrites. DeepSeek V4 has 128k context – use it to keep entire module in context, but ask for single function modifications.
rules.workflow: Open file → copy entire module into chat → ask 'modify function X to do Y' → paste back only changed function → test.

rules.title: Unit test generation alongside code
rules.description: For every bugfix, ask DeepSeek to generate a pytest unit test that would have caught the bug. Store tests in tests/ directory.
rules.example_prompt: Now generate a pytest test that verifies proximity_matrix is non‑zero for intersecting entities.

rules.title: Error handling and logging
rules.description: All generated code must use logging (logger = logging.getLogger('Moodpasta.<module>')) with levels: DEBUG for verbose geometry, INFO for normal, WARNING for repaired geometries, ERROR for fatal issues. Never print(), always logger.

rules.title: Type hints and docstrings
rules.description: Enforce type hints for all function arguments and returns. Docstring must describe: purpose, parameters, returns, raises, and example.
rules.example:
def compute_confidence(empirical_len: float, calibrated_len: float, total_len: float) -> float:
    """Compute epistemic confidence index.
    
    Args:
        empirical_len: Total length of empirically validated paths (mm)
        calibrated_len: Total length of calibrated paths (mm)
        total_len: Total path length (mm)
    
    Returns:
        E_confidence in range [0,1]
    
    Raises:
        ValueError: If total_len <= 0
    
    Example:
        >>> compute_confidence(1000, 500, 2000)
        0.625
    """

rules.title: Version stamping
rules.description: Every generated function that changes output format must update the VERSION string at top of file. Ask DeepSeek to increment patch version (2.2.x → 2.2.x+1) for bugfixes, minor version (2.2 → 2.3) for new features.

deepseek_v4_integration_golden_rules.workflow_summary: 1. Prime context (function signature + constraints). 2. Generate code. 3. Run test suite. 4. If fail, refine prompt with error message. 5. Once pass, commit with message linking to handoff task ID. 6. Update golden master JSON.

Run: diff test_output_v22/26_skladba_index.json new_output/26_skladba_index.json (only timestamp and version differ)
Check: v_slot_double_pass_length_mm present in ML CSV and > 2 × single_pass

appendix_deepseek_v4_api_tips.system_prompt: You are an expert Python developer specializing in CAD/CAM, DXF parsing, Shapely geometry, and deterministic algorithms. You follow coding best practices: type hints, docstrings, logging, unit tests. You never use string heuristics for layer classification. You always refer to external configuration for machine parameters. You ensure all outputs are deterministic. You add validation_status for any heuristic value.
appendix_deepseek_v4_api_tips.cost_saving: Cache context in local files – send only diff of relevant module, not whole 2000‑line file each time.
